mapper.select: select id, role_id, organization_id, department_id, position_id, enabled, sync_mode, create_time, update_time from role_assignment_rule where role_id = #{roleId} order by create_time desc

insert ignore into user_role_relation (id, user_id, role_id, source_id, organization_id, create_time, create_user) values

mapper.select: select count(*) from ( select target.user_id, target.source_id from user_role_relation target where target.role_id = #{roleId} and not exists ( select 1 from user_role_relation other_rel inner join user_role other_role on other_role.id = other_rel.role_id where other_rel.user_id = target.user_id and other_rel.source_id = target.source_id and other_rel.role_id <> #{roleId} and other_role.enabled = b'1' and other_role.id <> 'member' ) group by target.user_id, target.source_id ) impacted

insert into workflow_definition (id, code, name, scene, scope_type, scope_id, default_flow, active_for_new, enabled, description, version, lifecycle, published_time, published_by, source_flow_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{id}, #{code}, #{name}, #{scene}, #{scopeType}, #{scopeId}, #{defaultFlow}, #{activeForNew}, #{enabled}, #{description}, #{version}, #{lifecycle}, #{publishedTime}, #{publishedBy}, #{sourceFlowId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select id, code, name, scene, scope_type, scope_id, default_flow, active_for_new, enabled, description, version, lifecycle, published_time, published_by, source_flow_id, create_time, update_time from workflow_definition where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into workflow_role (id, flow_id, code, name, role_type, role_id, field_key, source_type, source_key, match_mode, enabled, create_time, update_time) values (#{id}, #{flowId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{roleType}, #{roleId}, #{fieldKey}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceKey}, #{matchMode}, #{enabled}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select id, flow_id, code, name, role_type, role_id, field_key, source_type, source_key, match_mode, enabled, create_time, update_time from workflow_role where flow_id = #{flowId} order by create_time asc
mapper.insert: insert into status_flow_role_permission (id, flow_id, status_flow_id, workflow_role_id, visible, operable, enabled, create_time, update_time) values (#{id}, #{flowId}, #{statusFlowId}, #{workflowRoleId}, #{visible}, #{operable}, #{enabled}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
